args.description: Materializes contributor churn metrics including first/last commit timestamps, total active span in days, commit frequency, and inactivity status (churned if inactive > 30 days).
args.sql_query:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE contributor_churn AS
SELECT 
    author, 
    repo, 
    count(*) as total_commits,
    min(committed_at) as first_commit_at, 
    max(committed_at) as last_commit_at,
    date_diff('day', min(committed_at), max(committed_at)) as active_span_days,
    date_diff('day', max(committed_at), current_timestamp) as days_since_last_commit,
    CASE 
        WHEN date_diff('day', max(committed_at), current_timestamp) > 30 THEN TRUE 
        ELSE FALSE 
    END as is_churned
FROM github_commits
GROUP BY author, repo;

The query calculates for each author and repository:
- **`total_commits`**: Total number of commits authored.
- **`first_commit_at` & `last_commit_at`**: Onboarding and most recent contribution timestamps.
- **`active_span_days`**: Duration between first and last commit in days.
- **`days_since_last_commit`**: Time elapsed since their latest activity.
- **`is_churned`**: Flag indicating if a contributor has been inactive for more than 30 days relative to the repository's latest commit.
